customManagers.description: Images pinned as name:tag@sha256:digest in actions and workflows, e.g. hadolint and actionlint in the lint actions
Tool versions an action defaults to, marked by a # renovate: comment above the input's default

packageRules.description: lint-kotlin checks the detekt jars against lint-kotlin/checksums.txt, and tests/lint-kotlin.test.sh fails until the new version's are there
prBodyNotes: Add the SHA-256 of the new version's `detekt-cli-…-all.jar` and `detekt-formatting-…jar` (or `detekt-rules-ktlint-wrapper-…jar` from 2.0) to `lint-kotlin/checksums.txt` before merging.
